about.title: Ugar n 50 Iseggasen n Ulɣu deg Zamura
about.body: Hostel boutique-aneɣ itteddu deg wudem wis 3 n yiwen n ufrag s liftit, ɣef uɣerbaz aqdim n Zamura. Nessexdem akk azal nniḍen i tmurt-ik: tigmmiwin s uɣanib anurweɣ, afssi uzgen, WiFi, asekniw anamun... d tticca.
about.since: Ugar n 50 iseggasen d yiwen · Pensión Padornelo d Hostal Sol
about.history1: Tmazirt-aneɣ tebda deg 1975, mi ara izenz uɣil-aneɣ Pensión Padornelo deg Calle Aire, Zamura. Iseggasen bezzaf, asaɣel-nni n uɣil yella d aẓar i yimezdaɣ isuɣen ɣer tmdint, yesɛa iɣil ɣef wansuf-is d tigmmiwin ttwassqiyen.
about.history2: S uzmez, s tezmert tettekkan d trustin n uḥuli, uɣil ixdem i usmel-is: Hostal Sol ibda deg Calle Benavente, d Restaurante Padornelo, d tazwara n tmurt. Ugar n 50 iseggasen n uɣil deg lhotiluri aqqarent ɣef yal tinzert.
about.history3: Ass-a, s isnasen imsegnan s uɣanib anurweɣ d uminimalist, nessexhed myd i yessalmen yid-aneɣ: ulɣu n uɣil, tigmmiwin ttwassqiyen, d tmuɣli ɣef Zamura. Nheddar deg ufus n uɣerbaz aqdim, ɣeblent Akatidral, leglisan irumaniyen d iɣrem iɣemriyen imeqqranen.

reviews.ctaBand: Aɣ tenzert s uneqdec deg usmel-aneɣ d isemɣan imezwura garantiiyen

items.name: Gemma
items.text: Yufa-yi-d amkan-is, uɣanib n hostel imsebhalen lqayen d unebdu yelhan. Asexsi n tasa yeffer-iyi-d, tuɣalin-nneɣ d taseɣwa!

items.name: Iker Zulueta
items.text: Deg ufus n uɣerbaz aqdim, tigmmiwin imeqqranen, ttwassqiyen d tsennan. Ansuf n yimellalen d lɛanaya. Ad ternuɣ!

items.name: José Manuel Serrano
items.text: Amkan iqerb bezzaf, nkemmel s wucrar. Unebdu-nni n yisliman yelha. Mẓi.

items.name: Annayara
items.text: Dawaleɣ d yiwen n unari yeɣlin d srid-nni, ffeɣen-iyi-d taɣimt tameqqrant. Izlan-nni d netta ara nsen.

items.name: Javier Fidalgo
items.text: Amkan d lkamal. Ttwassqit bezzaf, d akk ayen ixuṣṣen, amkan d lɣib d unebdu-nni n umlalaj yelhan. S lamin ad nternuɣ.

items.name: Carla Aguilar
items.text: Hostel yelha deg ufus n tmdint. Sselkimen-aɣ ayen ara nẓer d igezman nniḍen. S lamin, ad nternuɣ.

items.name: L. Elisabeth
items.text: Ttwassqit, d isenfal, d abrirki. Imellalen d lɛanaya n unebdu. Isleḥ ur nerni hostel-a.

items.name: Juan Manuel
items.text: WiFi tettedda yelha, zemreɣ ad xedmeɣ s wamek ixuṣṣen. D lamin ad terniɣ s tura.

items.name: Thomas K. (DE)
items.text: Sehr zentral gelegen, saubere Zimmer und freundliches Personal. Kann ich nur empfehlen!

items.name: Marie L. (FR)
items.text: Excellent rapport qualité-prix. Chambre propre, bien équipée et idéalement située dans le centre historique.

items.name: James H. (UK)
items.text: Great location right in the historic centre. Clean rooms, helpful staff. Would definitely stay again.

items.name: Valentina R. (IT)
items.text: Ottima posizione nel centro storico, stanza pulita e personale cordiale. Consigliato!

items.name: Pedro A. (PT)
items.text: Localização perfeita no centro histórico. Quartos limpos e pessoal simpático. Recomendo!

restaurant.title: Restaurante Padornelo
restaurant.body1: S tikkal ttimɣarin seg hostel, tettaf Restaurante Padornelo, araten iban d hostel-aneɣ d yisem n lɣiwwer aqdim n uɣil. Twaɣni taẓerɣant n Zamura d igezman aɣerbiyen, timad d isemɣan ilelliyen.
restaurant.body2: Tapas, raciones, aɣrum s usennan d iẓuranen n D.O. Toro. Ayen ur yettili ur tessebhilet deg unebdu-k deg Zamura.

items.q: D acu akud n hostel-aneɣ?
items.a: Takseḍt s uselkin: 10:00-21:00. Check-in: 14:00-21:00. Hostel yettegg ɣef 21:00 s wamek ilaq. Awwen n 21:00 ur nezmir ara ad nsell tenzert ur tettwasiɣa. Deffir check-in, teɣed tsarut d tili s wamek tebɣiḍ. Uḥad s-d-yettunan, maca ma tusa-d Asebḥas tzemreḍ ad teqqimed akk Ahad. Imudan n tasut netteddar, ɣar 14-16 Ɣuct, 15 Dujamber d 1 Yennayer.

items.q: Akud n check-in d check-out?
items.a: Check-in: 14:00-21:00. Ma tusa-d deffir 14:00 nzmer ad nesɣel kus-nnik deg talalt s wamek ilaq. Deffir check-in, tettafeḍ tsarut. Check-out: 11:00. Deffir check-out, nzmer ad nesɣel kus-nnik deg ass n uffeɣ (ɣar Ahad). Ad aɣ-tennerniḍ. Ma tusa-d deffir 21:00, ur nezmir ara ad k-nsell.

items.q: D acu izerfan ixuṣṣen i check-in?
items.a: Ɣef Umarur Aɣelnan 933/2021, akk imuddar ur yettin ara 14 iseggasen ilaq ad d-yekmil asnilfu azerfan s tenwalt: DNI, asefsar, NIE, TIE neɣ tiɣet n tesnuɣinest n UE. Izerfan imttuyen, yemmalen, ur nettaɣent ara, neɣ ik-d-yussun s imayl neɣ WhatsApp ur ttqebleɣ ara. Akk imuddar ilaq ad d-yuɣal d asnilfu-is; asnilfu n umuddar amezwaru kan ur ikafi ara. Chekin s usiɣen deffir n tili ittuneɣ.

items.q: Hostel iḥemmel imezdaɣ n tneskit?
items.a: Hostel itteddu deg wudem wis 3 n yiwen n ufrag s liftitin sin. Ulac iɣerriben i tewwurt neɣ i tigmmiwin. Tzemreḍ ad tẓerḍ tiwlafin d vidéo deg tasɣunt i usali ma yella amkan yesɛa aya i ixuṣṣen-ik. Ma yella lḥajat-ik, mudd-aɣ-d awal.

items.q: Yella uwanag?
items.a: Hostel ur isɛi ara uwanag uzgen, maca yella ixiyen bezzaf iqerben. Parking Plaza Constitución (3 dqiqa, 1,45€/saɛa, 14,70€/ass, 24 saɛa) d aqerban ugar. D Parking Plaza de la Marina Española (5 dqiqa, Empark). Ma tbɣiḍ s tamajjant, agar n tren (2 km, bus L3) isɛa uwanag n tamajjant 24 saɛa. Ɣef tewwurt n hostel yella ORA (aberkani, 0,35€/30 dqiqa, ugar 3 saɛa).

items.q: Amek ara d-tafeḍ hostel seg agar neɣ seg tagrawla n bus?
items.a: Agar n tren d tagrawla n bus hemlen deg Avenida de las Tres Cruces, s 2 km seg hostel. Ixiyen: taxi (5-7 dqiqa, s 6-8€), bus n tmdint Axet 3 (El Acercame, 0,95€) taɛmirt 'Mercado' (5 dqiqa s uqim seg hostel), neɣ s uqim s 25-30 dqiqa. Agar n tren isɛa uwanag n tamajjant 24 saɛa d tasɣelt n kus.

items.q: Amek ara tẓeddeɣ takrurt deg Zamura?
items.a: Aɣanib amezwaru: Radio Taxi Zamora (tel. 980 531 515). Tzemreḍ ad tettareḍ takrurt ɣef talɛabt ɣef agar neɣ ɣef isegra n tmdint. Tafekka seg agar ɣer hostel: s 6-8€, 5-7 dqiqa. Ixiyar yexdem ugar s yiwen n tudert d kus.

items.q: Amek ara tafeḍ IFEZA seg hostel?
items.a: IFEZA (Instituto Ferial de Zamora) itteddu s 4-5 km seg hostel. Bus Axet 5 (El Acercame, 0,95€). Takrurt: s 10 dqiqa, 8-10€. Asgid: deg imukan imeqqranen, imyugaren nessexded ibusaten n tamajjant (navettes) seg tmdint ɣer IFEZA. Lqem-d asmel aɣelnan n umyager deffir. Imukan isɛiyen deg IFEZA: Fromago (Timenna Tamattant n Afulus), imyugaren Zeta, SIFER.

items.q: Yella imensi n uffaɣ deg hostel?
items.a: Ur nesɛi ara imensi n uffaɣ, maca yella bezzaf n lecwayat d lxabz iqerben. Ansnas: Bar Restaurante Padornelo, s wanaw n 2 dqiqa s uqim seg tewwurt n hostel. Yettfettaḥ Aainas-Amghar deg 10:00 d imensi n uffaɣ n ifurka s isemɣan ilelliyen.

items.q: Tierrin llant deg hostel?
items.a: Ih, d lhossen n tierrin laneɣ. Tierrin llant s usawen n 7€/tudert s yal animale. Tzemreḍ ad tfeyyed deg usmel s usiɣen s uqeddem aɣelnan. Asenqed: akk tyelɣa ilaq ad ttekkint d midɣen akk akud. Ur tzemmin ara ad qqiment s tizlit deg taɣimt, deg hostel, deg takrurt neɣ fella. Ma yella ur ttettufaɣent ara ɣas, animale-nni ad yeffeɣ.

items.q: Zemreɣ ad sfefkeɣ tiɣri-nni s tizlit deg taɣimt?
items.a: Ala, ur d hostel n tyelɣa neɣin. Akk tyelɣa ilaq ad ttekkint d midɣen akk akud. Ur tzemmin ara ad qqiment s tizlit deg taɣimt, deg hostel, deg takrurt neɣ fella. Ma yella ur ttettufaɣent ara ɣas, animale-nni ad yeffeɣ d tenzert-aneɣ ad tettufarreɣ s tyezna.

items.q: Yella WiFi deg tigmmiwin?
items.a: Ih, yella WiFi n tamajjant deg akk hostel, d akk tigmmiwin. Tafat n useddu tettuwekked deg akud n check-in. Tarrayt tazeggaɣt tefdeq 50 Mbps deg ñu dëkk tigmmiwin — ikaf i tnegna, imayl, streaming d ticrawin agiriwin. Nettestit-d ak bezzaf n yilmeẓyen s wawank d wamek s useɣzef. WiFi yelha i umahil deg tgejda.

items.q: Yella afran deg tigmmiwin?
items.a: Ih, akk tigmmiwin llant d afran d asekniw. Anagraw amaynut d aẓayez i tfennayt s tmeẓa s wamek ilaq ass nniḍen. Tzemreḍ ad tseqqeḍ tarrayt. Ma tebɣiḍ tallalt deg us-xedmem, imellalen d lɛanaya ad k-wannen.

items.q: D anaw n télévision i yella deg tigmmiwin?
items.a: Tigmmiwin s taɣult llant d télévision s tgert 32 inces, kra d Smart TV. Tigmmiwin s wudem n yimɣi llant d TV 18 inces (ur d Smart TV ara), maca tzemreḍ ad trawet iwalen s HDMI.

items.q: D asekkif n talɣa?
items.a: Hostel itteddu deg wudem wis 3, 2 tsaratin ixuṣṣen i tewwurt (n ufrag d n hostel). Tuɣalin deg iɣerbazen imɣaren llant d iẓuran n talɣa. Yal taɣimt isɛa asexlec-is, d nettaf ilaq ad testelqiḍ tawwurt-im ɣef kul tikelt.

items.q: Yella tasa n tidi, aɣennaj neɣ asfur deg tigmmiwin?
items.a: Ala. Maca yella bezzaf n imensa iqerben. Talalt tzemmer ad k-ttawin ɣef isansawen ma tebɣiḍ ayen.

items.q: Yella uselkim n usafar n idrimen?
items.a: Hostel ur isɛi ara uselkim n usafar n idrimen, maca yella bezzaf n lavanderías s tizlit iqerben. Aqerban yella deg Calle San Torcuato, s wanaw n 5 dqiqa s uqim. Imɣi d inglasen d linge de lit t-ɣen deg isemɣan n taɣimt d usawen amezwaru. Bɣit tisɣal nniḍen, ɣer talalt.

items.q: Yella uselkim n usafar n taɣimt ass-nniḍen-ass?
items.a: Ih, nesɣel uselkim n usafar ass-nniḍen-ass i tsɣunit n taɣimt ttwassqiyen d tsennanin. Ahad ulac uselkim. Ma tetteddeḍ Asebḥas, taɣimt tettedda deg akk Ahad, check-out deg 11:00 Aainas.

items.q: Yella asexsi n uqercuc neɣ tasnifest?
items.a: Ih, yella asexsi n uqercuc d tsnifest ɣef tuɣalin deg talalt, s wara iqedden. Ɣer talalt akud ara tebɣiḍ. Deffir us-xedmem, fek-id deg taɣimt d imellalen ad t-sweɣren. Aselkim n tamajjant.

items.q: D acu i yella deg taɣimt?
items.a: Akk tigmmiwin llant: linge de lit ameqqran (draps, couvertures, tinfilalt, duvets), imɣi (1 neɣ 2 ɣef umuddar ɣef usnaw n taɣimt d tẓirit), agellid aɣerfan (aqlal, tilalt n yider, takbant neɣ agender s tiɣennin, aglim, iẓri), afssi uzgen imezzaɣen s waman d lkad d tfessalt d papiye. Ɣef tuɣalin n tamajjant: asexsi n uqercuc d tasnifest. Ulac tasa n tidi, aɣennaj neɣ asfur.

items.q: Yella waman iɣewwaden?
items.a: Ih, yella waman iɣewwaden akk akud. Deg kra n tigmmiwin waman iɣewwaden ttddan, maca s 5 dqiqa ad tafeḍ waman iɣewwaden. Ma yella ugur, mudd-aɣ-d awal s wura ilaq.

items.q: D acu isemɣan-nwen?
items.a: D axtir amezwaru n Zamura aɣelnaɣ. Isemɣan tettgaggin ɣef useggas d usnaw n taɣimt (uzgen, taywalt, s taɣult). Wussan n tasut d imukan llant d isemɣan iɣewan dɣa. Ɣef tẓirit n 11 druṭ, 10% tawuri otomatik. Aɣ tenzert s usmel-aneɣ — isemɣan ilelliyen ugar n Booking, Expedia d wiyaḍ.

items.q: Yella tawuri i tẓirit yennuɣan?
items.a: Ih, seg 11 druṭ tella 10% tawuri otomatik ɣef isemɣan imeqqranen. Tawuri tettewali ɣef isemɣan ur ttuttufaɣent ara. Ma ur tettɣewwit ara s usmel s wamek ilaq, mudd-aɣ-d awal. Tawuryin n tɣawan llant — steqsi-d.

items.q: Zemreɣ ad feyeɣ s tektabt?
items.a: Ih, nettqebbeḍ tiktebin imeqqranen: Visa, MasterCard, American Express d wiyaḍ. Asparam d usenfer s yiwen n lefsad (s usnas n simana). Tiktebin n cek ur netteqbel ara.

items.q: Llant tigddamin tizdatinin?
items.a: Ih, ɣef tuɣalin s 25€/tudert. Tzemreḍ ad t-tukkeḍ deg tenzert (3 imeqranen) neɣ mudd-aɣ-d awal. 3 tigddamin n uzekka-ɣ akk — asali ilmend. 1 tagelda n uzekka ugar deg taɣimt. Tɣawat imeqqranen, ɣ tenzert tigmmiwin tamdant.

items.q: Llant wussan n Ahad d imukan?
items.a: Netteddar ugar n imukan, ɣar: 14, 15 d 16 Ɣuct, 15 Dujamber d 1 Yennayer. Uḥad ur netteddar ara, maca ma tusa-d Asebḥas tzemreḍ ad teqqimed akk Ahad — check-out deg 11:00 ass n uffaɣ.

items.q: Zemreɣ ad wweḍeɣ deffir 21:00?
items.a: Check-in: 14:00-21:00. Hostel yettegg ɣef 21:00 s wamek ilaq. Ur nezmir ara ad nsell check-in deffir 21:00 s wamek ilaq. Maca, deffir check-in, teɣed 3 tsaratin (n ufrag, n hostel d n taɣimt-ik) i us-kkeḍ d uffaɣ s wamek tebɣiḍ, 24 saɛa.

items.q: D aɣellas hostel?
items.a: Hostel isɛa tifilin d ttaẓat imaynin imeddinen deg 2026 i usali n usferki n yideɣ. Maca usferki gar tigmmiwin d aneɣlay, kra n tigmmiwin zemrent ad ttilin s yideɣ. Ma tbɣiḍ taɣimt d aɣellas, aɣ-d-sersen deg tenzert neɣ check-in.

items.q: Wweḍeɣ talalt, ulac amdan. D acu ara xedmeɣ?
items.a: Amezwaru, siɣeḍ ɣer ucelɣum n hostel: +34 980 533 152. Kra n tikkal nheddar ɣef ubrid neɣ nettsell tikcebin nniḍen neɣ imuddar nniḍen. Asenqed: takseḍt s uselkin taɣelnanit — ur netteqbel ara tikceḍin n WhatsApp. Ma deffir takseḍt ur d-twaskket ara, qqim kra n dqiqat d seddus-d. Wakud n ulɣu: 10:00-21:00.

items.q: Siɣeɣ maca ur d-ttwaskkeɣ ara.
items.a: Lqem-d ubelɣu: +34 980 533 152. Kra n tikkal tikceḍin bezzaf d ur nezmir ara ad nsell akk. Ɣer deffir deg 10 dqiqat. Imayl hostalsol{'@'}outlook.com neɣ WhatsApp +34 639 980 253. Asenqed: tikceḍin n WhatsApp ur netteqbel ara.

items.q: Sufre-d asɣim ɣef ubrid n wakud. D acu ara xedmeɣ?
items.a: Ma twehleḍ deg hostel (tsarut dameɣ) d yiwen n asɣim ameqqran: amellali n waman, ugur n lektrik neɣ yiwet n tkala ur tettara ara, mudd awal ɣer uẓar n asɣim ɣef ubelɣu i k-ttuwekked akud n check-in. Ilaq ad t-tsiɣḍeḍ 4 tikwal s umata i yemlalen imellalen ad t-slen. Nettaf tiseqdawin d nessawel i kra n ugur deg wakud n ulɣu (10:00-21:00).

items.q: Bɣiɣ ad aɣeɣ tenzert maca asali ur banit ara. Tzemrem?
items.a: Ma ass i tbɣiḍ deg 2-3 ayyuren, ur d ittxemmen ara. Lqem-d asmel kra-kra i tuɣalin n ifrazan. Sɣiven ur yella ara. I wussan imeqqranen am Semana Santa neɣ imugren Zetta, kra n tikkal nxelq asɣiv.

items.q: Zemreɣ ad aɣeɣ tenzert s uselkin?
items.a: Tura, nettqebbeḍ kan tenzert s usmulkumal s usmel. Tenzert s uselkin kan (s wara n wusmulkumal) ur tettewali ara. Aɣ tenzert s uneqdec seg usmel-aneɣ — isemɣan imezwura n tamajjant. Ma yella ugur, siɣeḍ +34 980 533 152 neɣ +34 639 980 253.

items.q: D acu ayen ixuṣṣen i tenzert?
items.a: Nxuṣṣ: isem ameqqran, ubelɣu n uselkin, tawɣit n imayl, tansut d ixrayen n ufyi. Deg tili, akk imuddar ur nettinit ara 14 iseggasen ilaq ad d-ykemmil asnilfu azerfan (DNI, asefsar, NIE, TIE neɣ tiɣet n tesnuɣinest UE) ɣef Umarur Aɣelnan 933/2021. Akk imuddar ilaq ad d-yuɣal d asnilfu-is, mači kan amuddar n tenzert.

items.q: Ma ur d-yufi ara imayl n ussfel n tenzert?
items.a: Ma ur d-yufiḍ ara imayl n ussfel, mudd-aɣ-d awal s uselkin, imayl neɣ WhatsApp. Yemken yiwen ugur n unagraw d tenzert ur ttwasɣel ara. Mudd-aɣ-d awal s tura i sferkinit n ugur n asali. Lqem-d d spam bi.

items.q: Zemreɣ ad ɣreɣ tenzert n taɣimt taɣara?
items.a: Ih, sken-aɣ-d s yiwen n uɣmis, WhatsApp neɣ uselkin d nettama. Asenqed: ur nezmir ara ad nɣel taɣimt taɣara, maca nettemma ɣef asali. Sken-aɣ-d s tura. Zemreḍ ad tiniḍ ifraran: tyuri n tallit wis 1/wis 2, taɣimt d aɣellas.

items.q: Amek ara sfereɣ tenzert-iw?
items.a: Tzemreḍ ad tsfereḍ s tamajjant aqlal ɣer 48 saɛa deffir tili (ɣar isemɣan ur ttuttufaɣent ara). Sferid s ufrar deg imayl n ussfel neɣ seg yikunt n usmel. Asuttar ilmend n wakud n ufyi — s 5-15 wussan n uxeddim. Ma yella tenzert seg usmel-nnit (Booking, Expedia), serreḥ ɣer usmel-nni.

items.q: Amek ara ɣreɣ tnefkilt?
items.a: Tzemreḍ ad ɣreḍ tnefkilt seg ass aneggaru n tẓirit ɣer 30 wussan deffir check-out. Deg tenzert, ɣelleẓ akk ilmawen ixuṣṣen (isem, ubelɣu n ufran, tansut). Tnefkilt tettusseggas s imayl s PDF. Ur nezmir ara ad nkemmel tinefkilin deffir 30 wussan.

items.q: Ma sfeld-d taɣra deg hostel?
items.a: Ma teẓriḍ ur d-tawiḍ ara ayen s-d-twiḍ, mudd-aɣ-d awal s wura ilaq. Nessɣel iwalen yettumsefden 30 wussan. Deffir 30 wussan, iwalen ur nefɣa ara tettuseɣlen neɣ tettuselkinen. Ma tbɣiḍ ad tessegdasneḍ ɣer tansut nniḍen, mudd-aɣ-d awal. Uselkim n teffɣa s ɣef uccuč-ik.

items.q: Ur ittzeddig ara isemɣan. Yella weɣlan?
items.a: Isemɣan-aneɣ d imezwura n Zamura aɣelnaɣ. Ma teẓriḍ yella ugur deg isemɣan, azen-aɣ-d imayl. Ɣef tẓirit n 11 druṭ+ tella 10% tawuri. Aɣ tenzert toqbalent s usmel-aneɣ — ilelliyen ugar n Booking, Expedia d wiyaḍ.

items.q: Bɣiɣ ad aɣeɣ tenzert maca sɛiɣ isteqsiyen nniḍen. Amek ara muddɣ awal?
items.a: Tzemreḍ ad muddedḍ awal s uselkin +34 980 533 152, WhatsApp +34 639 980 253, neɣ imayl hostalsol{'@'}outlook.com. Ma ktebḍ d ur d-nssuzzeɣ ara deg 3 wussan, seɣ-d cliɣ. Wakud n uselkin: 10:00-21:00. Tikceḍin n WhatsApp ur netteqbel ara.

items.q: Zemreɣ ad snfuɣeɣ?
items.a: Asnfaq yettwaxrez deg akk hostel, d tigmmiwin, tifilin, tiγullawin d iɣerbazen imɣaren. Ma ur teslelid ara ɣas, tiγrim n 100€ ɣer 1.000€ i usfey d usefsas. Tisni, tizemmarin d ubxur ur ttqubal ara.

items.q: Zemreɣ ad sɣeɣ abiskil?
items.a: Ih, tzemreḍ ad tsɣeḍ abiskil deg taɣimt-ik s wamek yella ttwassqa (s wara n lwehel neɣ timeddakkent). Aɣ-aɣ-d awal deffir tili i ussenzi taɣimt tameqqrant. Liftit tedda, taseɣzeft n abiskil ameqqran, ilaq ad yili s ttul.

items.q: Tẓirit yennuɣan, yella ayen nniḍen?
items.a: Ih, seg 11 wussan 10% tawuri otomatik ɣef isemɣan imeqqranen. Ɣef isemɣan ur ttuttufaɣent ara. Tɣawat d tẓiriyin ennig nniḍen nzmer nessers isɣalen — mudd-aɣ-d awal. Ma tawuri ur tettɣewwit ara s usmel, seqqeḍ-aɣ-d.

items.q: D anaw n tutlayin ara tettkellim deg hostel?
items.a: Imellalen deg hostel ttkellimt Spaniya kan. Ma tbɣiḍ ad tkellmeḍ s tutlayt nniḍen, kteb-aɣ-d WhatsApp neɣ imayl d nettessel s imergiten n tsuqilt. Deg tili, qq deg WiFi n tamajjant d seqdec seg uselkin-nnik Google Translate, DeepL neɣ Bing Translator.

items.q: Zemreɣ ad aɣeɣ tenzert s yisem n wayeḍ?
items.a: Ur nettemmal ara. Iqel: yal amuddar ad yaɣ tenzert s yisem-is (isem ameqqran d ubelɣu n uselkin ttwasɣeln yid-s). Ma taɣiḍ i wayeḍ, ɣelleẓ deg tanqalt isem ameqqran d ubelɣu n uselkin, d wayeḍ ad yekmel Chekin s usiɣen s ixrayen-is. Ubelɣu n tenzert kan ur ikafi. Tiwlafin n tmaẓilt ur netteqbel ara. Ma yella lfehm, ad nsiɣeḍ ɣer umuddar n tenzert i ussfel.

items.q: D acu n wallalen i yellan deg tigmmiwin?
items.a: Afssi uzgen, wifi (tsarut d ugar n usali llant deg lkaɣeḍ n deffir n tewwurt), aglim d iẓri, asekniw (s uṣeggem otomatik), afran s tmeẓa, TV s tmeẓa, asexsi n uqercuc d tsnifest s tuɣalin, asendel, tifeḍt, tagelda d inglasen. Deg ufssi ad tafeḍ lkad n umezwaru, acampu d lkad n ufus, d imɣi. Ma tebɣiḍ ayen nniḍen, mudd-aɣ-d awal.

items.q: Anwa i ixelqen asebter-agi n web?
items.a: Asebter-agi n web ixelq-it Juan Manuel Béc (https://juanman.tech/). Azamul n uẓar d aqbel d yella deg GitHub: https://github.com/JuanmanDev/HostalSolZamoraWeb2026

checkin.arrivalInfo: Imellalen ad skednin tenzert-ik. Tzemreḍ ad tfeyḍeḍ ma yella ayen (tigddamin tizdatinin, tigeldiwin n umẓi, wussan nniḍen, ...). Izerfan n akk imuddar ad ttwaskdnent. Ma check-in Chekin s usiɣen tenna, uselkim dɣa itedduu yakan. Ad k-ssiwlen amek ara seqdeḍ tsaratin i us-kkeḍ ɣer hostel s wamek tebɣiḍ. Ma tbɣiḍ asexsi n uqercuc neɣ tasnifest, ɣer talalt s wura. Teɣed 3 tsaratin d ad k-sselken amek ara tent-seqdeḍ i tewwurt n ufrag, n hostel d n taɣimt-ik.
checkin.roomInfo: Tallalt amek ara qq ɣef WiFi, akud n uffaɣ d isɣalen n hostel: asnfaq yettwaxrez (tiγrim ɣer 1.000€ i usfey d usefsas), tisni tettwaxrezza d yideɣ n yid tettwaxrezz.
checkin.checkoutInfo: Ẓu tsaratin deg tablut i tettaf deg tuzni deffir n liftit. S tfadda, ffeɣ taɣimt deffir 11:00 i team n usafar am wakud. Nzmer d nesɣel kus-nnik deg ass n uffaɣ (ɣar Ahad), mudd-aɣ-d awal d nesserɣ.

galeria.title: Tasɣunt n Tigmmiwin — Hostal Sol Zamora
galeria.heading: Tasɣunt n Tigmmiwin
galeria.description: Tiwlafin d vidéo imezwuren n tigmmiwin, s wara n urmid neɣ tarmitin.
galeria.p1: Deg Hostal Sol Zamura nettemmal d asuddes d aɣerbaz amezwaru. Fad tettefkeḍ tiwlafin d vidéo imezwuren n tigmmiwin-aneɣ — s wara n urmid neɣ tarmitin — i wakken ad tẓerḍ i tenzert s wamek tebɣiḍ.
galeria.p2: Iṭṭij yal anaw n taɣimt: anaw n ugennaj, aɣanib, agellid, tmuɣliyin d ticreḍ yemlan. Vidéo yessaramen ad tisiḍ amkan am wak llalent fad.
galeria.p3: Yella kra n usteqsi ɣef yiwen n taɣimt taɣara? Kteb-aɣ-d neɣ siɣeḍ — nettama bezzaf i wakken ad k-nwenneḍ ɣer ixiyar n uɛejb ɣef tẓirit-ik.
galeria.p4: Tiwlafin ttwarnent deg 2024 · Vidéo ttwasɣalent deg 2026. Nxeddem isɛeddilen deffir-agi, maca uɣanib d aɣanib d yal.

sobreNosotros.title: Fell-aneɣ · Iqerb, Aɣellas, d Timmad — Hostal Sol Zamora
sobreNosotros.description: Ugar n 50 iseggasen deg lhotiluri n Zamura, seg Pensión Padornelo ɣer Hostal Sol.
sobreNosotros.heading: Axxam Yesɛan Tafat d Tmurt i Yettken Ansuf n Lɛali
sobreNosotros.intro1: Ansuf ɣer axxam-aneɣ, axxam nniḍen, ameẓẓyan d yifri iẓrin i k-yettwaksen i wakken ad tehniḍ deg umkan n iqerb d aɣellas. Seg tewwurin-is feqqent bezzaf n imektuben, imussaɣen seg bezzaf n tmura n tudert d yemdanen s iɣewwaren nniḍen i itwamlulen ɣef wakal-aneɣ.
sobreNosotros.intro2: Seg 2023 Hostal Sol ittwasserreɣ s yiwen n uɣil d 50 iseggasen ugar n tazdeɣna deg usekkar n ulɣu. Neɛda s yiluɣan, s wamek ur nessineɣ, d taxuya. Deffir bezzaf n umahal d labur — d ufekkan i uneḥbus amezwaru — nxelleq hostel ɣer uneqqis, nefkad axxam-aneɣ akk ayen yestahlen d nzemmreɣ almen seg yal ameddak id yewweḍ fad.
sobreNosotros.intro3: Deg wakud s wara n iɣudan, nenna aneɣ ɣef tullisin n hostel: nesferrek d nesseɣzef tigmmiwin d nzenz-asent s uɣanib anurweɣ, amaynut d uminimalist, fad ara ikemlen taaw, iqerb d tsennayt d igezman imezwura.
sobreNosotros.philosophyBody: Tafelseft-aneɣ isɛa sin d sin n yisulfu imezwura: iqerb, aɣellas d timmad. Nsegdas tafelseft-nni ɣef yal azal deg tili d tibeddilt n tudert. Ansuf-aneɣ d aqerb, d attit ɣef tuffra-ik d imal-ik, d tagara tsetteq taaw-ik. Yal amussag yebnna abrid-is d nettemmal ad k-nwenneḍ i tettafeḍ deg axxam-aneɣ yiwen n umkan n jjnane ɣef ufus n tmdint tazegzawt am Zamura.
sobreNosotros.homeTag: Amkan i Wakken ad Tḥniḍ Seld Axxam
sobreNosotros.homeTitle: Ayefk, Iqess d s Wara n Yiluɣan
sobreNosotros.homeBody1: Hostel-aneɣ d amkan ameqran i imussaɣen isbedden tẓirit tyefkin d s wara n yiluɣan. Tigmmiwin tinenɣiyin d timdennanin d akk ayen ixuṣṣen: linge de lit n tefrant, imɣi imellalen, afssi uzgen s tasa d Wi-Fi n tamajjant deg akk asaɣul.
sobreNosotros.homeBody2: Deg talalt nesselkam ixrayen ɣef imukan n tsekka iqerben, igezman ameqqranen d tkerkasin n tamnaḍt, d akk isteqsiyen i txuṣṣeḍ deg tẓirit-ik.
sobreNosotros.locationBody: Nessexdar amkan d lɣib: ufus n Zamura, ɣef sin n tiddaren timezwura d 3 dqiqat s uqim seg Plaza Mayor d uɣerbaz aqdim. Tzemreḍ ad termejjed amazray n tmdint, ad teɣreḍ taggara-s d ad temjuged s wara n tuffra. Nheddar iqerb tkerkasin, igezman d igerwan n uwanag, s wara n wayyal n ula d ttdul n wedrar amecṭuh.
sobreNosotros.historyBody1: Tmazirt-aneɣ tebda deg 1975, mi ara izenz uɣil-aneɣ Pensión Padornelo deg Calle Aire de Zamura. Iseggasen bezzaf, asaɣel-nni n uɣil yella d aẓar i yimezdaɣ isuɣen ɣer tmdint.
sobreNosotros.historyBody2: S uzmez yebda Hostal Sol deg Calle Benavente, d Restaurante Padornelo, d tazwara n tmurt. Ugar n 50 iseggasen n uɣil deg lhotiluri aqqarent ɣef yal tinzert.
